requirements: Do not make a job pass by narrowing what it runs. If the full suite is too slow for every pull request, say so in the pull request body and propose the split rather than silently reducing coverage.
risks: A green build produced by a skipped gate is the failure this movement exists to remove; reproducing it in another form would close the movement without fixing anything.

in: Find why full-regression and po-scope-check evaluate to skipping on a pull request and make them run.

If a job is skipped by a path filter, a conditional or a required label, either the condition is corrected or the job is removed. A permanently skipped required check is worse than no check: it is green by construction.
State in the pull request body which condition was wrong and what it now evaluates to.
